# Poster workflow (events, internal communication, HR)

Applies to posters and similar single-page supports (flyers, infographics, slides, social visuals). It details the five steps of [`SKILL.md`](../SKILL.md) for this medium and never overrides [`guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md`](../../../../guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md). Anything `TO BE PROVIDED`: report it and ask.

## 1. Consult

Collect from the user, in one batch of questions if missing: format and size (no official format is documented), audience, goal, exact text (keep wording, accents and language), mandatory information (date, place, contact), supplied assets, and the output the tool can produce.

Then read the sources listed in `SKILL.md` step 1 and write the source manifest (read / viewed / inaccessible).

## 2. Select

Fill this dossier before producing; each line names its source or says "TO BE PROVIDED / needs validation":

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Colors | Role -> token -> HEX, per [`TOKENS.md`](../../../../guidelines/TOKENS.md). Brand orange: see `BRAND_RULES.md` Colors. Poster roles are `TO BE PROVIDED`: propose and flag. |
| Typography | Documented families and weights ([`BRAND_RULES.md`](../../../../guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md) Typography), and the font the tool can actually render. |
| Logo | Follow the selection procedure in [`BRAND_RULES.md`](../../../../guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md#logo): variant by background, size and clear space checked. Record the file, the background and the placed width in the dossier. |
| Illustration | A catalogued file when one fits (people scenes: people/workplace PNGs); otherwise [`illustration-creation.md`](illustration-creation.md). |
| Composition | Hierarchy and placement proposed and labelled as a proposal (no official grid). Text only over clear areas. |
| Method | **Composition from existing resources (preferred):** exact text, logo, tokens. **Image generation:** exploration only; it is never evidence of compliance. |

## 3. Create or modify

Build from the dossier without changing brand values. For an existing poster, keep its content, structure, logo and resources unless the user named the element to change; do not reconstitute any element from memory.

## 4. Verify

Run [`VISUAL_QA.md`](../../../../guidelines/VISUAL_QA.md) on the produced file. If the environment cannot display the output, visual checks are `Not verifiable`.

## 5. Deliver

Dossier, result, QA report, limits and open decisions, with the AI label. Overall status as defined in `VISUAL_QA.md`.
